rr-soul-robbery: The user consumes the target's soul, stealing the target's stat boosts, and then attacks.
rr-dark-hole: The user sends the foe to the shadow realm. It may cause sleep.
rr-leech-fang: An attack that absorbs half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.
rr-metal-bash: A physical attack in which the user charges, full body, into the foe.
rr-aqua-fang: The user bites the foe with aquatic force.
rr-forbidden-spell: The user conjures an ancient, corrupt spell that brings unexpected power.
rr-sonic-slash: The user attacks with a swift slash that becomes strong- er the faster the user is.
rr-draco-barrage: This attack beats fairy immunities but hurts the user. Changes split based off which is stronger.
rr-soupercell-slam: The user electrifies and slams the target. If it misses, the user takes damage instead.
